To: <datascienc...@ucdavis.edu>, DSI affiliates <dsiaff...@ucdavis.edu>


PROBLEM SOLVING IN DATA SCIENCES

This is just the kind of seminar you've always hoped would be held. Each seminar presenter will sketch out a current problem that they are working on, and seminar participants are expected to brainstorm with presenters on ways the problem could be tackled. Material from a variety of disciplines will be presented. The seminar is fun, enlightening, highly multidisciplinary and about
work in progress.

Come join us 11.50p-1p in 360 Shields Library.

This fall's presenters are:

Oct 12 (Wed), EXPLORER:  A Total-Body PET Scanner for Biomedical Research, Martin Judenhofer (and others), Biomed. Eng.

Oct. 19 (Wed), Field Sampling for Efficient Mapping of the Subsurface Geology, Prof. Jason Dejong, Civil and Env. Eng.

Nov. 3 (Thurs), Video-based quantification of anxious behavior in nonhuman primates, Prof. Andrew Fox, Psychology

Nov 30 (Wed), Finding Patterns in Media Framing of Policy Issues over Time, Prof. Amber Boydstun, Political Science
